clue.text: Firm public relations with a producer of oil

parts.note: CO is the usual abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A company's PR team teams up with an oil producer.
explanation.definitionFit: Copra is dried coconut kernel, pressed to yield coconut oil.

clue.text: Exclusive control of material for The Times, say, appropriately

parts.note: copy is text written for a newspaper, The Times being an example
rightly, in the right way; right as an adverb means fittingly

explanation.surface: Who owns the material printed in The Times, and is it used properly?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exclusive control of material' reads as one phrase, but the definition stops at 'control'; 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Copyright is the legal sole entitlement to reproduce a work.

clue.text: Importune by means of some multiple advances

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone presses their case through repeated approaches.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Importune by means' as the definition, but 'by means of' is the link joining the verb definition to the hidden-word wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To importune is to beg persistently, much as one would beseech or entreat.

clue.text: Defender of a game point

parts.note: polo is a game played on horseback
the gist is the main point of something

explanation.surface: A defender's role in a game is pinned to a single point.
explanation.definitionFit: An apologist argues in support of a cause or person.

clue.text: Keep company with eccentric queen, possibly

parts.note: to court someone is to woo or go about with them
a card is an amusingly odd person

explanation.surface: A suitor dates an oddball queen.
explanation.definitionFit: A queen is one of the picture cards in a pack, alongside king and jack.

clue.text: Small tray, not a deep vessel

definitions.meaning: a little mat or tray put under a glass or bottle
a ship that sails along the coast rather than across deep ocean

explanation.definitionFit: Both a drinks mat and a coastal trading ship go by this name.

clue.text: Just in the saddle, have girth adjusted

parts.note: a rider in the saddle is up

indicators.note: the letters of girth are adjusted, set in a new order

explanation.surface: A rider mounts and tightens the horse's girth strap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adjusted' rearranges GIRTH to RIGHT; 'have' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An upright person is honest and fair, a just one.

clue.text: Small bird hides bill, it is understood

indicators.note: the bird word hides the bill inside it, enclosing it

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird
AC, short for account, is a bill

explanation.surface: A little bird conceals a bill, so everyone grasps it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it is' is a link before the definition, though it reads as part of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Tacit means implied without being spoken.

clue.text: Fit to take up melody? Good!

parts.note: an air is a tune
worthy means good, deserving

explanation.surface: Is someone fit to sing a tune well?
explanation.walkthrough: 'take up' means take up into the sky: an aircraft that is fit to fly.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft judged safe to fly is certified this way.

clue.text: Bumper car loses tail in evasive movement

indicators.note: the bumper car word drops its final letter, its tail

parts.note: a dodgem is a fairground bumper car

explanation.surface: A fairground car swerves away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses tail' removes the M from DODGEM; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A dodge is a quick sidestep to avoid something.

clue.text: One no longer flies from vandalised seaport and ancient city

indicators.note: the letters of seaport are wrecked and rearranged

parts.note: Ur is the ancient Sumerian city in Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: Someone flees a wrecked port and an old city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flies' looks like flees; it is about flying. 'vandalised' turns SEAPORT into PTEROSA.
explanation.definitionFit: This extinct flying reptile is a creature that once flew and now does not.

clue.text: Copper flushed of face having smoked, perhaps

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a flushed face is red

explanation.surface: A red-faced policeman has been smoking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' suggests a policeman, but gives the chemical symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: Smoking is one way of preserving meat or fish, as is salting.

clue.text: Show blood type on pistol point?

indicators.note: the blood group is put on, added after, the other pieces

parts.note: rod is old American slang for a gun
E, east, is a compass point
O is one of the blood groups

explanation.surface: A gun's barrel reveals a blood type.
explanation.definitionFit: A rodeo is a public exhibition of cowboy skills.

clue.text: Circus act —-hardly profitable line

parts.note: tight margins leave little profit, so money is tight
a rope is a line

explanation.surface: A circus turn on a line that barely makes money.
explanation.definitionFit: Walking a high wire is a classic big-top performance.

clue.text: One working on lights is more remiss after midnight

indicators.note: the remiss word comes after the midnight letter

parts.note: G is the middle letter of night
lazier means more negligent

explanation.surface: A night worker gets slacker after twelve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lights' are window panes, not lamps.
explanation.definitionFit: A glazier fits glass into windows, which are called lights.

clue.text: An upright seat, perhaps, for backsliders

parts.note: a post is an upright pole

indicators.note: perhaps signals that seat may be rearranged

explanation.surface: A straight-backed chair suits those who slip back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges SEAT to ATES.
explanation.definitionFit: Apostates abandon their faith, falling back from it.

clue.text: Reversible rubbish vehicle a tower of strength?

indicators.note: reversible says the rubbish and vehicle words are read backwards together

parts.note: rot is nonsense, rubbish
a cart is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A dustcart that can turn round is a pillar of strength.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reversible' turns ROTCART round as a whole.
explanation.definitionFit: A farm tractor is a powerful machine for pulling, hence a strong towing thing.

clue.text: Daring young man light and delicate? It's unusual!

parts.note: aerial can mean airy, light and delicate

indicators.note: unusual signals the letters of it's are shuffled

explanation.surface: A bold young man is surprisingly graceful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' rearranges ITS to IST. The definition recalls the song 'The Daring Young Man on the Flying Trapeze'.
explanation.definitionFit: A trapeze artist performs high in the air, like the daring young man of the song.

clue.text: Like carrots, say, raw and topped?

parts.note: raw meat or skin is red
headed means having a top

explanation.surface: Uncooked carrots with their leafy tops still on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carrots' is slang for red-haired people.
explanation.definitionFit: Carrot-top is a nickname for a ginger person.

clue.text: Dance of couple backing favourites

parts.note: a couple is two

indicators.note: backing means the favourites word goes backwards

parts.note: pets are favourites

explanation.surface: A pair bets on the favourites at a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The two-step is a ballroom dance.

clue.text: Reading course?

definitions.meaning: a reading is an extract from a text
a course or route through somewhere

explanation.definitionFit: A passage is both an excerpt of writing and a way through.

clue.text: Deviated from way? Ready to change?

parts.note: St, street, is a way

indicators.note: ready is to be changed, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone wanders off course, willing to change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to change' rearranges READY to RAYED; 'from' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To have strayed is to have wandered off the right path.

clue.text: Seasoned in the ways of military bands?

indicators.note: the seasoned word goes inside the ways

parts.note: STS, streets, are ways
ripe means mature, seasoned

explanation.surface: Someone seasoned in army ways.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bands' are not musicians but strips of braid.
explanation.definitionFit: Stripes on a sleeve are strips of cloth showing military rank.

clue.text: Agent to speed up early acts in variety?

indicators.note: in variety signals the letters of early acts are mixed

explanation.surface: Who speeds up the opening acts at a variety show?
explanation.walkthrough: 'variety' suggests music hall, but signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A catalyst is a substance that speeds a chemical reaction.

clue.text: Number abandoned in Split

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
left means abandoned

explanation.surface: A number abandoned in Split, the Croatian city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Split' looks like the Croatian port; it is the definition. 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleft means split, divided.

clue.text: Take a breather to get energy for charge

parts.note: a lung is what breathes
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Pause for breath, then make a charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breather' is not a rest but the organ that breathes.
explanation.definitionFit: A lunge is a sudden forward thrust, an attack.

clue.text: Misapplication of hearty custom

parts.note: a hearty is a sailor, as is AB, able seaman
use is custom, habit

explanation.surface: Misuse of a cheerful custom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hearty' is a noun here: an old word for a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: Abuse is wrong or improper use.

clue.text: Perfect state?

definitions.meaning: complete, absolute, as in a perfect fool

explanation.definitionFit: Utter means complete as an adjective and to speak as a verb.

clue.text: Inwardly digested in school, would you say?

indicators.note: asks how the school's name sounds when spoken

parts.note: Eton is the English public school

explanation.surface: Learning absorbed at school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Inwardly digested' plays on 'read, mark, learn and inwardly digest'; Eton is a famous English boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: Food taken in and digested has been consumed.

clue.text: Retired father aimed to get settled

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn, so the father word goes backwards

parts.note: pa is father
pointed means aimed

explanation.surface: A retired dad settles in his aim.
explanation.definitionFit: Settled, fixed, as a date is appointed.

clue.text: To nibble smaller amounts is inelegant

parts.note: to taste is to nibble a little
less means smaller amounts

explanation.surface: Eating in tiny bites is poor form.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasteless means lacking refinement.

clue.text: All in, having tried desperately

indicators.note: desperately signals the letters of tried are thrown about

explanation.surface: Exhausted after a desperate attempt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'All in' means exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: Being all in is being worn out.
